code:
name: PR Comment
on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize]

jobs:
  comment:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions: { pull-requests: write }
    steps:
      - uses: marocchino/sticky-pull-request-comment@v2
        with:
          header: ci-result
          message: |
            {{comment_body}}
